title: FERI: A Multitask-based Fairness Achieving Algorithm with Applications to Fair Organ Transplantation
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The focus is on fairness across demographic subgroups defined by age, gender, and race/ethnicity in the context of liver transplantation.
models_tested: FERI (Fairness through the Equitable Rate of Improvement)
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a variable or focus of the study.
